name: Amasaka Yuuji
source:
The protagonist of this game, who has acquired the transformation ability. (Renameable)
He attended a private school, but moved to Yuka  public school because of his parents' circumstances.

He is a handsome guy, but he is a perverted gentleman who always wants to transform into something a girl wears.
And he gained his transformation ability and made his delusion a reality.

"Oh, I want to be a girl's pants...!"
